```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`DSEMr` supports both extended `lavaan` formulas and section-based SEM/Mplus
model scripts, compiling `VARIABLE`, `DEFINE`, `ANALYSIS`, and `MODEL` sections
into the exact same canonical intermediate representation.

Supported script constructs include:

- `TYPE = TWOLEVEL RANDOM`, `TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM` (DSEM3), and
  `TYPE = CROSSCLASSIFIED RANDOM`
- `TINTERVAL = time(delta)`, `LAGGED = y(1) x(1)`, `CATEGORICAL = u1-u4`,
  and `CENSORED = y (b)` / `(a)`
- `DEFINE: CENTER x (GROUPMEAN [cluster] | GRANDMEAN);`
- Named random slopes (`s | y ON y&1;`), random log residual variances
  (`logv | y;`), sparse fixed-zero lags (`y ON y&1@0 y&2;`), residual dynamics
  (`y^ ON y^1;`), dynamic CFA/IRT (`BY` with `(&1)`, `*`, `@value`, and
  cross-level equality `(1-4)`), and `PRIOR = PSEM`

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

lavaan_model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
script_model <- mplus_to_dsem("
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    y ON y&1;
", time = "time")
identical(lavaan_model$terms, script_model$terms)

# Three-level DSEM compilation
m3 <- mplus_to_dsem("
  VARIABLE: CLUSTER = clinic patient;
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM; ESTIMATOR = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    s | y ON y&1;
    logv | y;
    %BETWEEN patient%
    y;
    %BETWEEN clinic%
    y s logv WITH y s logv;
", time = "occasion")
print(m3)
```
